summary: You decide exactly which policies each persona and monitor covers.

new.title: Leave any policy out of a persona
new.text: In Manage personas, untick a policy to keep it out of that persona, and tick it again to take it back.

new.title: Remove any policy from a monitor
new.text: Remove from monitor now works for every policy, and the confirmation says what happens to each. Add to monitor takes a left-out policy back.

new.title: Persona column shows your personas
new.text: On the Conditional Access page, the Persona column lists every persona that takes a policy, and filtering finds policies that are in several.

new.title: Personas are fully yours
new.text: The built-in personas are only a starting list, made once from your policies. After that you can change or delete any of them.
